mapper.insert: INSERT INTO salary_closed_attendance( closed_ym, sabun, standard_days, worked_days, absence_days, leave_days, overtime_hours, status, updated_at) VALUES( #{closed_ym}, #{sabun}, #{standard_days}, #{worked_days}, #{absence_days}, #{leave_days}, #{overtime_hours}, '완료', NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE worked_days = #{worked_days}, absence_days = #{absence_days}, overtime_hours = #{overtime_hours}, status = "완료"

INSERT INTO salary_ledger( pay_ym, sabun, base_pay, overtime_pay, meal_pay, national_pension, health_insurance, long_term_care, employment_insurance, income_tax, local_income_tax, net_pay, status ) VALUES ( #{pay_ym}, #{sabun}, #{base_pay}, #{overtime_pay}, #{meal_pay}, #{national_pension}, #{health_insurance}, #{long_term_care}, #{employment_insurance}, #{income_tax}, #{local_income_tax}, #{net_pay}, '대기' )
mapper.select: select base_salary, meal_allowance, from salary_contract where sabun = #{sabun} and (end_date is not null and now() between start_date) and (end_date is null and now() >= start_date) order by created_at DESC limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into salary_contract( sabun, base_salary, meal_allowance, start_date, end_date ) values( #{sabun}, #{base_salary}, #{meal_allowance}, #{start_date}, #{end_date} )
